page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on KVM hypervisor technology and x86_64 architecture. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, featuring 16 physical cores and 32 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading enabled. The system includes 128 GB of RAM, offering a balanced 4 GB of memory per core. Cache configuration consists of 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 33 MB L3 cache per socket. Instruction set support includes AVX, AVX-512, AES cryptography, and FMA capabilities. The instance does not feature local disk storage or GPU hardware, relying on network storage while providing 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluation reveals trade-offs between single-threaded and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics perform in lower percentile tiers due to the 2.5 GHz base frequency. However, multi-core performance scales effectively across all 32 vCPUs, delivering average results in stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, software compilation using Clang, and PassMark CPU tests. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 119.7 GB/sec, supporting steady data throughput. The instance demonstrates consistent average throughput in database operations, static web serving, and Redis SET processing at up to 23.48 million operations per second.

Given its standard vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance provides predictable compute density for multi-threaded enterprise applications without requiring dedicated acceleration hardware. The absence of local disk requires external network volume attachment. It is suitable for middle-tier web serving, distributed caching layers, build pipelines, and general database tasks.
